text: Can anything be more foolish than that men who have all the opportunities which prosperity, wealth, and great means can bestow, should secure all else which money can buy, horses, servants, splendid upholstering, and costly plate, but do not secure friends, who are, if I may use the expression, the most valuable and beautiful furniture of life?
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
